grid: DFC2019 JAX_068 truth grid (UTM 17N, 0.5 m, 512 x 512), which contains the block's owned 250 m square

surface.top: maximum of the release's rendered-depth points per cell (ellipsoidal height)
surface.missing_top: filled from the nearest valid cell for ground estimation only; such cells stay unknown
surface.ground: 5th percentile of the filled top surface in a 51 x 51 cell (25.5 m) window

ndvi.bands: WorldView-3 MSI band 5 (red) and band 7 (NIR1), 1-based in the 8-band crops
ndvi.reflectance: top-of-atmosphere: L = DN * absCalFactor / effectiveBandwidth; rho = pi * L * d^2 / (ESUN * cos(90 - meanSunEl)); Maxar gain/offset adjustments not applied
ndvi.earth_sun_distance: astronomical formula from the acquisition date (first line time)
ndvi.views_note: The three most nadir training views (4.8, 5.9, 7.3 degrees off nadir); the May 2 holdout is never used
ndvi.sampling: each cell's top-surface point projected through each view's crop RPC, nearest pixel; median over views

priority: water: inside an OSM natural=water polygon and hag < 2 m
building: hag >= 2.5 m and (inside an OSM building polygon, or NDVI < 0.20 and outside every road buffer; the latter counted as unmapped)
road: inside an OSM highway buffer and hag < 2 m
unknown: anything else, or no top surface

splats: A splat within 1.5 m below its cell's top surface (or above it) takes the cell class. Deeper splats inside an OSM building polygon with hag >= 1 m are building (walls); other deeper splats, and splats outside the grid, are unknown.
osm: artifacts/reference/osm-jax068/osm.json (snapshot 2026-10-30, ODbL); the imagery is 2014-2015, so map features are confirmed by the model's height or spectra as above

evaluation.truth: artifacts/reference/dfc2019-jax068/JAX_068_CLS.tif (2 ground, 5 vegetation, 6 building, 9 water, 17 bridge, 65 unlabelled)
evaluation.scored_cells: truth not 65 and not 17; geometry as built (no registration shift)
evaluation.strict: our unknown cells count as incorrect in overall accuracy and in every class IoU

rule: Thresholds, widths, views and targets are fixed now and are not changed after any further evaluation.
changes_from_v1: DFC2019 class 5 is high vegetation (trees); lawns are labelled ground. v1 mapped all NDVI >= 0.30 to class 5, so 33,817 lawn cells scored as errors (vegetation recall 0.88, precision 0.20). v2 splits vegetation at 2 m height above ground into trees (class 5) and grass (scored as ground).
True ground cells sit a median 1.8 m above the 25 m ground estimate in this model (registered lidar MAE about 1.4 m), so v1's 1 m 'low' limit left many ground cells unknown. v2 uses 2 m.
independence: Both changes were chosen after seeing v1's errors on JAX_068, so a v2 score on JAX_068 is a diagnostic, not an independent result. The first independent v2 test needs labels for another area.
result: training/semantics/v2-jax068-diagnostic.json: diagnostic on JAX_068 only (not independent): overall accuracy 0.683, building IoU 0.702, tree IoU 0.292; targets still not met.
